concerns.text: Plan commits to 'a sensitivity analysis will also be run using alternative cut-offs (e.g., ROR > 1.5, PRR > 1.2) to assess robustness' but no task implements the alternative-threshold run; T007 only covers the Flu-only baseline. Add a task or strike the plan element.

Plan Phase 3 item 10: 'Optional stratified disproportionality analyses by age group (<18, 18-64, >=65) and sex are performed as exploratory checks; results are reported in supplemental tables' — no task performs age/sex stratification or produces supplemental tables. Either add a task or remove the plan element.

Plan Phase 3 item 9 presents a minimum-detectable-effect analysis ('with >=5 reports the ROR confidence interval width is <= 0.5') as a performed justification for the >=5-report filter, but no task computes or reports it. Add a task or drop the claim from the plan.
